verdict.rationale: Together AI's serverless docs say developers can call 100+ open-source models with per-token pricing and no provisioning latency, on a shared serverless tier with a shared prompt cache and per-model dynamic rate limits. That is a broad open-weight catalog on shared endpoints. However, the pack never names which families are on serverless: Llama appears only in a dated community post, and Gemma only as a dedicated-endpoint example. Missing for 10: documented serverless availability of Llama, Qwen, DeepSeek and GPT-OSS, evidence the catalog stays current with new releases, and independent corroboration of catalog breadth.

support.subject: As a developer, I can choose among a broad catalog of current open-weight model families (Llama, Qwen, DeepSeek, GPT-OSS and peers) on shared serverless endpoints

citations.quote: Call 100+ open-source models with per-token pricing and no provisioning latency.
Send the same prompt prefix again and any portion that's still warm in the shared cache is billed at the cached rate.
Each organization has a dynamic rate per model that adjusts based on: The model's live capacity.
